info.title: Kadmo API
info.description: Start and follow Kadmo work over HTTP with an API token. Every answer is JSON; every refusal is `{ error, code }`.

get.description: The member the token acts as, their account and role, and the token itself. A cheap call to test a credential.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying.

post.description: Queue a workflow in a workspace. The job starts `queued` and an agent of the account takes it. A job can spend the account’s credit.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. The same key with the same request within 24 hours answers the first answer again and writes nothing.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma-separated: `queued`, `running`, `needs_input`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled`, or `finished` for the last three.

parameters.description: The job’s id.

post.description: File a ticket in the workspace’s tracker, or as an internal task, and add it to Tasks as `pending`. It does not start: run a playbook on it to start work.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. The same key with the same request within 24 hours answers the first answer again and writes nothing.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying.
Whole seconds to wait before retrying.

get.description: A task of the account’s Tasks, with its status, its playbook and its runs.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The task’s key, as its tracker or Kadmo gave it.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying.

post.summary: Run a playbook on a task
post.description: Approve the task with a playbook. The run starts when nothing holds it — the tasks it depends on, its workspace’s pool, a step only a person can do: 201 with the run when it started in the call, 202 with what it waits on when it did not, and it then starts on its own. A task not in Tasks yet is added from its tracker. A run can spend the account’s credit.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The task’s key, as its tracker or Kadmo gave it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. The same key with the same request within 24 hours answers the first answer again and writes nothing.

202.description: The task is approved; the run starts once what it waits on clears.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying.
Whole seconds to wait before retrying.

post.description: Make a subscription of the token’s member: each event it lists is POSTed to the URL, signed with the subscription’s secret, and retried for 24 hours when the endpoint fails. The answer carries the secret, this once.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. The same key with the same request within 24 hours answers the first answer again and writes nothing.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying.
Whole seconds to wait before retrying.

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying.

delete.description: Delete one of the token’s member’s subscriptions: nothing more is delivered to it, the deliveries still waiting included.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The subscription’s id.

post.description: A job ended: succeeded, failed or cancelled. Sent once its files and report have arrived, at most ten minutes after the end.

parameters.name: Kadmo-Event
parameters.description: The event, as `type` in the body.

parameters.name: Kadmo-Delivery
parameters.description: The delivery’s id, as `id` in the body: the same on every retry.

parameters.name: Kadmo-Timestamp
parameters.description: This attempt’s time, in Unix seconds: refuse one older than five minutes.

parameters.name: Kadmo-Signature
parameters.description: `v1=` and the lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256 of `<Kadmo-Timestamp>.<body>`, keyed with the subscription’s secret; several values may be listed, separated by commas.

200.description: Any 2xx answer is a delivery. Any other is retried for 24 hours; a 410 disables the subscription.

apiToken.description: An API token (`kadmo_api_…`), created in Settings › Assistant.

user.description: The member the token belongs to and acts as.

account.description: The member’s account: everything the token reads and starts is in it.

role.description: The member’s role in the account.

token.description: The token this call presented — its name as the member gave it.

id.description: The job’s id: given when it is dispatched, kept for its whole life.

status.description: `queued` until an agent takes it; `needs_input` while it waits on a person; the last three are its end.

workflow.description: The workflow it runs, by name.

anyOf.description: The workspace the job belongs to.

task.description: The task it works on, when it names one.

input.description: The workflow’s inputs it was dispatched with.

agent.description: The agent that took it; null while queued.

status.description: `paused` waits on a person (an approval or a fork to pick); `finished` carries its `outcome`.

outcome.description: How a finished run ended; null until then.

step_index.description: The step the run is on, from 0.

anyOf.description: The playbook run the job is a step of.

question.description: What the person is asked: the agent’s question, plan or request, or that a gate waits for approval.

options.description: The answers the agent offered, when it offered some.

url.description: Where it is answered: the job’s page in the app.

needs_input.description: While `needs_input`: an approval a gate waits on, or a question of the agent — the oldest one open. Answer it in the app.

result.description: What the agent reported, once it has; null before.

error.description: Why it failed or was cancelled, when something recorded why.

app_job_id.description: The app’s job number, once an agent took it.

url.description: The job in the app: its page once an agent took it, the queue before.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

project.description: The tracker’s project or team; null for internal.

new_tasks.description: Where a task created in the workspace is filed.

required.description: False when the workflow has a default for it.

parameters.description: The inputs it reads, as keys of a dispatch’s `input`.

status.description: `paused` waits on a person (an approval or a fork to pick); `finished` carries its `outcome`.

outcome.description: How a finished run ended; null until then.

step_index.description: The step the run is on, from 0.

TaskRun.description: A playbook run on the task.

key.description: The task’s key, as its tracker names it: what `{key}` is in a path.

status.description: `pending` awaits an approval; `waiting` is approved and waits on a blocker or a pool slot; the last three are its end.

in_pool.description: False once the task was archived from Tasks.

tracker.description: Where the ticket lives: `internal` is Kadmo’s own.

anyOf.description: The workspace the job belongs to.

workspace.description: The workspace the task belongs to; null while none is known.

playbook.description: The playbook a run of it starts; null until one is chosen.

run.description: The run the task is bound to now; null while none is.

runs.description: Its runs, newest first, at most 20.

url.description: The task’s page in the app for an internal task, else its tracker’s.

run.description: The run that started; null while it waits.

reason.description: `blocked_by`: tasks it depends on are not done; `pool_full`: its workspace runs as many playbooks as it may; `person_step`: a step only a person can do comes first; `blocker_failed`: a task it depends on failed or was cancelled; `role_not_runnable`: no agent of the account can run a step’s role; `retrying`: the start failed and is retried.

blockers.description: The keys it waits on, for `blocked_by` and `blocker_failed`.

waiting_on.description: What the start waits on; null once the run started.

url.description: The https URL each event is POSTed to.

items.description: `job.finished`: a job ended (succeeded, failed or cancelled); `job.needs_input`: a job waits on a person; `task.done`: a task is done.

anyOf.description: The workspace the job belongs to.

workspace.description: The one workspace whose events it takes; null for every workspace.

status.description: `disabled` receives nothing until it is enabled again on the Integrations page.

disabled_reason.description: Why it was disabled: `failing` — its endpoint failed every delivery for 24 hours; `gone` — its endpoint answered 410. Null while active.

created_by.description: The member who made it: it is theirs, and goes when they leave the account.

last_delivery_at.description: When its endpoint last took a delivery; null before the first.

url.description: The https URL each event is POSTed to.

items.description: `job.finished`: a job ended (succeeded, failed or cancelled); `job.needs_input`: a job waits on a person; `task.done`: a task is done.

anyOf.description: The workspace the job belongs to.

workspace.description: The one workspace whose events it takes; null for every workspace.

status.description: `disabled` receives nothing until it is enabled again on the Integrations page.

disabled_reason.description: Why it was disabled: `failing` — its endpoint failed every delivery for 24 hours; `gone` — its endpoint answered 410. Null while active.

created_by.description: The member who made it: it is theirs, and goes when they leave the account.

last_delivery_at.description: When its endpoint last took a delivery; null before the first.

secret.description: The secret every delivery is signed with (`Kadmo-Signature`). Shown this once: keep it where the receiver reads it.

id.description: The delivery’s id: the same on every retry of it, so a receiver drops a repeat by it.

type.description: The event; `ping` is a test delivery sent from the Integrations page.

api_version.description: The payload’s version: fields are added to it, never renamed or removed.

created_at.description: When the payload was composed, before its first attempt.

webhook_id.description: The subscription it was delivered to.

job.description: For `job.finished` and `job.needs_input`: the job, as `GET /jobs/{id}` answers it.

task.description: For `task.done`: the task, as `GET /tasks/{key}` answers it.

data.description: The object the event is about; empty for a `ping`.

error.description: What went wrong, as a sentence for a person.

code.description: What a client branches on: stable, one per kind of refusal.

details.description: For `invalid_request`: each field refused, by its path in the body.

issue_types.description: For `invalid_issue_type`: the types the account files.

ticket_key.description: For a `tracker_error` or an `orchestrator_error` after the ticket was filed or the run created: its key. A retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` answers this again.

run.description: For `run_active`: the run that drives the task. For `orchestrator_error`: the run that did not start.

role.description: For `role_not_runnable`: the role no agent of the account can run.

workflow.description: The workflow to run, by name (`GET /workflows`).

workspace.description: The workspace it runs in, by slug (`GET /workspaces`).

input.description: The workflow’s inputs, by name: `ticket_url` and `hint` among them when it reads them.

effort.description: An effort tier of the account (`low`, `medium`, `high`, or one of its own); unset, the workflow’s default.

workspace.description: The workspace the task belongs to, by slug (`GET /workspaces`).

description.description: The ticket’s description, as plain text or Markdown.

type.description: An issue type: `Task` when unset. An internal task takes a type of the account’s routing map.

tracker.description: `workspace` (the default) files where the workspace files new tasks (`GET /workspaces`); `internal` files a Kadmo task.

playbook.description: The playbook to run, by slug (`GET /playbooks`).

workspace.description: The workspace to run in, by slug; unset, the task’s own.

effort.description: An effort tier of the account (`low`, `medium`, `high`, or one of its own); unset, the account’s default.

hint.description: A note every step’s agent reads.

sync_status.description: Move the ticket’s status in its tracker as the run goes; unset, the playbook’s default.

validate.description: Check the delivered work once the run ends; unset, the account’s default.

url.description: The https URL to POST each event to. Every address its host resolves to must be public.

events.description: The events to deliver: at least one.

workspace.description: Only this workspace’s events, by slug (`GET /workspaces`); unset, every workspace’s.
